notes: Physically impossible combination in one paragraph. Tests that technical contradictions are flagged.
input: Field inspectors need the inspection app to work fully offline in basements with no signal. All data must sync instantly to head office so supervisors see results the second an inspection is completed. Inspectors upload up to 50 high-res photos per inspection. The app must stay under 20 MB and never store data on the device for security reasons.

questionsAbout: whether encrypted on-device storage is acceptable
what happens when two people edit the same inspection
conflicts: works fully offline vs never stores data on the device
instant sync vs no signal in basements
50 high-res photos per inspection vs no on-device storage
mustNotInvent: a named mobile platform stated as explicit
